decision: accept scientific repair and23structured dependency-use reviews
scope_amendment: General compact topological groups are retained with explicit multiplication measurability for the product Borel sigma-algebra; no unsupported unrestricted compact-group assertion. The existing Lie-group data proves this condition in1.2; no additionalChoice/Radon theory is introduced.
proof_review: Root read the full original and repaired source. Composition of inversion, pairing and measurable multiplication proves product measurability; finite group words make both tree and triangular row coordinate maps bimeasurable. Fubini on finite probability products proves inversion/coordinate measure preservation and factorizes the positive continuous density. µ bi-invariance is now explicit as equality on all Borel translates, and generic links are called elements rather than matrices.
consumer_review: Same repair owner read all3unchangedSU2 consumer claims/proofs and recorded exact qualifying uses; SU2 is finite-dimensional and second-countable, so new1.2 supplies the condition. Root checked that this is a genuine stated special case, not a restriction to Lie groups.
limits: Actual scoped repair/readings and version bindings only; no new external reading or independent whole-frontier proof acceptance, publication or native battery pass.
